passage.text: My best friend is Emma. She's from Canada.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈbɛst ˈfrɛnd ɪz ˈɛmə. ʃiːz frəm ˈkænədə.

passage.text: We met at university, and now we're roommates.
passage.reading: wiː ˈmɛt ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti, ənd ˈnaʊ wɪr ˈruːmmeɪts.

passage.text: Emma has long blond hair and a big laugh.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈhæz ˈlɔːŋ ˈblɑːnd ˈhɛr ənd ə ˈbɪɡ ˈlæf.

passage.text: Emma is the most loyal friend I have.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ɪz ðə ˈmoʊst ˈlɔɪəl ˈfrɛnd aɪ ˈhæv.

passage.text: When I'm sad, she always knows how to cheer me up.
passage.reading: wɛn aɪm ˈsæd, ʃiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈnoʊz ˈhaʊ tə ˈtʃɪr miː ˈʌp.

passage.text: She tells silly jokes and makes funny faces until I laugh.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈtɛlz ˈsɪli ˈdʒoʊks ənd ˈmeɪks ˈfʌni ˈfeɪsɪz ənˈtɪl aɪ ˈlæf.

passage.text: She's also extremely generous: she shares her food, her clothes and her books with me.
passage.reading: ʃiːz ˈɔːlsoʊ ɪkˈstriːmli ˈdʒɛnərəs: ʃiː ˈʃɛrz hɜːr ˈfuːd, hɜːr ˈkloʊðz ənd hɜːr ˈbʊks wɪð miː.

passage.text: She's a bit messy, and she's a little careless in the kitchen!
passage.reading: ʃiːz ə ˈbɪt ˈmɛsi, ənd ʃiːz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈkɛrləs ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən!

passage.text: But she's the person I trust most, and I'm very happy that she's my friend.
passage.reading: bʌt ʃiːz ðə ˈpɜːrsən aɪ ˈtrʌst ˈmoʊst, ənd aɪm ˈvɛri ˈhæpi ðæt ʃiːz maɪ ˈfrɛnd.
